dct_description_sm:
This data set contains the polygons delimiting the woods of the agglomeration of Montreal.

The boundaries of the woods and their composition are the result of an analysis of aerial photos and/or of field visits and/or of particular ecological studies. These are constantly updated in accordance with the advancement of knowledge in the community. Some plant communities and their limits may therefore be imprecise.**This third party metadata element was translated using an automated translation tool (Amazon Translate).**
